data.one_liner: Saves images and videos from network URLs or local files to device gallery.
data.what_it_does: Saves images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF) and videos (MP4, MOV) from a local file path or network URL to the device's native photo gallery or photos app on Android and iOS.
use_when: You need to save captured or downloaded media files to the user's device gallery.
You need to support saving both network and local images/videos on Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You only need in-app image picking without saving to the system gallery.
You need advanced image editing or compression before saving.
strengths: Supports both network URLs and local file paths
Handles multiple common image and video formats
Cross-platform support for Android and iOS
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific setup for permissions (iOS Info.plist and Android Manifest)
Limited to saving operations rather than full media management
data.setup_notes: Add NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription to iOS Info.plist. For Android 10 and below, add WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission to AndroidManifest.xml.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need to pick images or videos from the device camera or gallery rather than saving them.
